emails.subject: Premium Salt & Pepper Grinders — BRC/BSCI Factory, Kosher Certified
emails.body:
Hi there,

I'm Karen from Signature Senses. We manufacture premium salt and pepper grinders from our BRC and BSCI certified facility.

Here's what sets us apart:

THE SALT
Sourced from pristine Australian waters. Natural solar evaporation. High purity. Rich in natural minerals. No artificial additives — just clean, crisp sea salt.

THE PEPPER
Single-origin black pepper from Vietnam, the world's largest and most consistent producer. Exceptionally high piperine content for a powerful, aromatic kick that stands out.

THE GRINDER
Built-in ceramic mechanism. Grind fresh in seconds. Refillable glass bottle — reusable, eco-friendly, and designed to look great on any table or countertop.

CERTIFICATIONS
- BRC Certified Factory
- BSCI Certified Factory
- Kosher Certified (Salt & Pepper)

We also offer flexible packaging options beyond the grinder — bulk packs, gift sets, and seasonal formats.

I'd love to send you our full product catalog and discuss how Signature Senses could fit your range. Would you be open to a quick look?

Best,
Karen
Sales Manager
Signature Senses
sales@boxtray.com | www.boxtray.com
